comparison.objective: Unfold an attached tablet support and leave the tablet standing; candidate performs selective screen separation.
comparison.physical_skill: Manipulation of connected thin hinged panels, load transfer and stable tripod-like placement versus bimanual load sharing, sifting and loose-body retention.
comparison.success_condition: Tablet at 50–70° in portrait, desktop-supported, hands clear and stable for 5 seconds versus ≥98% media recovery, washer retention, dual support and 3-second dwell.
comparison.reason: Both end with released support, but the record tests deployment and static stabilization of an articulated assembly, not selective many-body passage.
